label: Health awareness days
h1: Health awareness days, with one good fact each

items.b:
World Diabetes Day.

Marks the birthday of Frederick Banting, co-discoverer of insulin.

World AIDS Day.

First held in 1988. HIV treatment can reduce the virus to undetectable levels, which prevents sexual transmission.

World Cancer Day.

Led by the Union for International Cancer Control. Many cancers are linked to tobacco, alcohol, inactivity and UV exposure, all things you can change.

World Hearing Day.

WHO campaign. Keep headphone volume moderate and take breaks; noise-induced hearing loss is permanent but preventable.

World Water Day.

UN observance about access to safe water. Your body is roughly 50–60% water by weight in adults.

World Tuberculosis Day.

Marks the day in 1882 Robert Koch announced the cause of TB. TB is preventable and curable.

World Health Day.

WHO's founding day (1948). Each year has a different health theme.

World Malaria Day.

Malaria is spread by the bite of infected Anopheles mosquitoes and is preventable and treatable.

World Hand Hygiene Day.

WHO's 'SAVE LIVES: Clean Your Hands' day. Twenty seconds with soap removes many germs that sanitiser misses.

World No Tobacco Day.

WHO campaign. Within weeks to months of quitting, circulation and lung function begin to improve.

World Blood Donor Day.

Thanks voluntary donors. One donation is split into components that can help more than one patient.

World Hepatitis Day.

Hepatitis B can be prevented by vaccine, and hepatitis C is curable with treatment.

World Alzheimer's Day.

Alzheimer's is the most common cause of dementia. Regular activity, blood-pressure control and hearing care are among the factors studied for risk reduction.

World Heart Day.

World Heart Federation. Your heart beats about 100,000 times a day.

World Mental Health Day.

World Federation for Mental Health. In the U.S., you can call or text 988 to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline.

World Food Day.

FAO's founding day. Fibre from beans, whole grains, fruit and vegetables feeds your gut bacteria.

World Osteoporosis Day.

Bone density peaks in early adulthood. Weight-bearing exercise, calcium and vitamin D help maintain it.

World Stroke Day.

Learn BE FAST: Balance, Eyes, Face, Arms, Speech, Time to call emergency services.

World Diabetes Day.

Marks the birthday of Frederick Banting, co-discoverer of insulin.
